title: Core: frame clipboard — cut/copy/paste frames
description: Implement frame-level clipboard operations in packages/core/src/engine/mutations.ts (or equivalent): copyFrames(doc, layerId, startFrame, endFrame) -> FrameClipboard, pasteFrames(doc, layerId, atFrame, clipboard), cutFrames(doc, layerId, start, end). These are separate from object-level copy/paste (0068). The Timeline panel needs Edit > Cut Frames / Copy Frames / Paste Frames. The clipboard is in-memory only (no OS clipboard). Store clipboard state in Shell.tsx as useState<FrameClipboard|null>. Wire to Edit menu and timeline right-click context menu. Add 8 unit tests in packages/core.
